description: Start here for any question about adopting AI in a company: the map of the ai-first.company evidence. Returns the company cases by the kind of work AI was used for (customer service, legal work, office assistant and others), the six themes (with counts of practices, cases and studies), the claim checks of widely repeated AI statistics, the groups of other figures, the company cases by outcome, the assessments by kind, and what each filter value and rating means. Then open the part that fits and fetch records with get_evidence.
name: start
title: Start here: the map of the evidence
